description: The provided grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the number of datasets over time, categorized by data sources. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Year" and displays discrete years in chronological order from 2012 to 2022. The vertical value axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and features a linear scale with a visible range from 0 to 100, marked by numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 20 and corresponding horizontal grid lines, though the data extends slightly above this range. The chart displays grouped bars for each year, typically consisting of a blue bar positioned on the left and an orange bar on the right. A legend titled "Data sources" indicates that the blue color corresponds to "1", while an orange square and a grey square are also present in the legend but lack explicit text labels. Visually, the blue bars increase in height from approximately 0 in 2012 to a peak of roughly 112 in 2021, which is the tallest bar in the chart. The orange bars also increase from about 2 in 2012 to a maximum of approximately 47 in 2021. The shortest visible bars represent values near zero, such as the blue bar in 2012 and the orange bars in 2013 and 2014. Notably, the bars for the final category, 2022, are visually distinguished from the rest of the chart by being rendered in lighter, faded shades of blue and orange, with approximate values of 30 and 7, respectively.
